plain_english_policy: Imposing contribution limits on political action committees (PACs) to state government candidates.

effects.rationale: Limiting PAC contributions directly restricts market autonomy in political financing by imposing regulatory constraints on financial flows into campaigns.

PACs often represent corporate or large-scale interests. Limiting their contributions disproportionately affects wealthy donors and organizations, which may bear the tax-like burden of reduced influence.
PACs are private entities. Restricting their contributions indirectly curtails their role in funding campaigns, which is a form of private provision.
